@s1 stated
  relation "land at"
  role subject "the user"
  role location "Stansted"
  role time "Monday"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "go to"
  role subject "the user"
  role destination "Kaplan Lettings"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "sign"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the lease"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "open an account at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Monzo"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "receive"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "NI number"
  role source "the post"
  role time "Tuesday morning"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "sign"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "the lease"
      role time ?t1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "open an account at"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "Monzo"
      role time ?t2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  order ?t2 after ?t1
